content.comment_body: Good evening, I am unsure whether communication is possible between one [product_name] controller and another [product_name] controller using S7 protocol. Can anyone clarify?
Yes, it's possible, similar to S7-200 communication through the VM area. Would you like an example?
Good afternoon, I do not have experience with the 200 series controllers. If it's possible, please share a sample program.
Networking [product_name] devices can be done easily with drag and drop functionality.

analysis.insight_summary: Users explored whether communication between two [product_name] controllers is achievable using S7 protocols. The conversation referenced similarities with S7-200 devices and discussed the ease of networking using drag and drop features. Initial uncertainty was resolved, and users showed interest in applying this in practice with a sample program.
analysis.user_expectations: Users were looking for simple support for S7 communication between [product_name] controllers, including practical guidance or sample implementations.
